elements.description: An agent run's restore points: pick a step, see what it captured and what going back discards, and go back.

properties.name: checkpoints
properties.description: The checkpoints, oldest first – one before each step of the run

properties.name: status
properties.description: The run: "running" (a live run), "paused", "done", "failed" – always set by the app

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The run's goal, shown as the heading

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The picked checkpoint's id. Picks apply unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: elapsed
properties.description: How long the run has gone on, in ms – the strip's length (defaults to the last checkpoint)

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder of the note that goes along with the restore

properties.name: restorer
properties.type: ((checkpointId: string, instruction: string) => void | Promise<unknown>) | undefined
properties.description: Called on restore (as well as tc-restore). May return a promise: the button waits, and says so if it rejects

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A step is picked or the pick is cleared (detail: { selected: string | null, checkpoint?: RunCheckpoint }); cancelable

events.name: tc-restore
events.description: "Go back to step N" pressed (detail: { checkpointId: string, instruction: string, discarded: string[] })

props.name: checkpoints
props.description: The checkpoints, oldest first – one before each step of the run

props.name: title
props.description: The run's goal, shown as the heading

props.name: selected
props.description:
The picked checkpoint's id. Controlled when defined (null = nothing picked); otherwise the component keeps it,
starting at `defaultSelected`

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the picked checkpoint's id, or null when the pick is cleared

props.name: onRestore
props.type: (checkpointId: string, instruction: string, discarded: string[]) => void | Promise<unknown>
props.description:
"Go back to step N" pressed: the checkpoint, the note for the agent ("" when none) and the ids of the steps it
discards. May return a promise – the button waits, and says so if it rejects

changelog: `tc-run-checkpoints` – a run's restore points as a list and a timeline: what each point captured, what going back discards (steps, file changes, tokens, cost), a note for the retry, and `restorer` that may return a promise. Listbox keyboard; `tc-selected-change`, `tc-restore`.
